description: Perth Metro LiDAR data is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. LiDAR (Light Detection And Ranging) is an increasingly popular remote sensing technology that uses light in the form of a pulsed laser (typically from an aircraft) to measure 'ranges', thereby being able to accurately calculate distances and elevations in a 3D environment. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are 2022, 2d, 3d, LiDAR, Metropolitan Perth. It offers 4 resource(s) in .pdf, .zip shapefile, file geodatabase, mapinfo mid/mif, pdf, shp. The portal shows 2025-09-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
